cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

mechanism: A supervises a warm gift and small move as though it were a final departure, increasing care while narrowing farewell language.
confusable: D141 warmth hides withdrawal; D237 warmth grows alongside increasingly final wording.
comparison: A tiny workplace relocation treated as farewell differs from a short journey packed for permanence.
seedUse: Keep teacup care but give B a concrete small move, and make professional packing respond to it.
